title: Fix Mcp App Tools to Use Official Mcp Apps Protocol
description: Fix the compose engine MCP app tools (show_design, show_diagram, etc.) to use the official MCP Apps protocol with @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/react. Currently the UI hangs because the tools use a custom protocol instead of the standard MCP Apps protocol with ui:// resources, tool meta, and the App class for postMessage communication.
summary:
Migrated MCP app tools from custom compose:init/compose:ready/compose:selectionChange postMessage protocol to official MCP Apps protocol. Key changes:

1. **main.py**: Changed _APP_RESOURCE_URI to ui://compose/design-viewer. Added _build_diagram_data() that pre-computes diagram points/lines from kit/design data via flattenDesignDict. Added @mcp.resource with text/html;profile=mcp-app MIME type. All 8 app tools now use meta={"ui": {"resourceUri": ...}} and return JSON strings with pre-computed diagram data instead of structuredContent/_meta dicts.

2. **mcp-app.tsx**: Rewrote as standalone lightweight SVG diagram renderer using React + @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/react useApp hook. No @compose/ui imports — renders circles for pieces and lines for connections with pan/zoom/selection. 320KB built (96KB gzip).

3. **vite.mcp-app.config.ts**: Simplified to minimal config with viteSingleFile plugin. No complex aliases needed since app is standalone.

4. **engine.test.py**: Updated all 11 MCP app tool tests from old structuredContent/_meta assertions to new JSON string format with points/lines/capabilities. All 164 tests pass.

5. **compose/ui/index.tsx**: Updated McpDesignViewer component to use new McpDiagramPayload format (points/lines/capabilities) instead of old McpDesignViewerPayload.
